title: Why Chicago Landscapers Prefer Bluegrass Sod for Premium Lawns
intro: For Chicago homeowners dreaming of a lush, emerald-green lawn that can withstand the city's diverse climate, the choice of turfgrass is paramount. While many options exist, one variety consistently stands out as the gold standard for premium lawns: Kentucky bluegrass. Renowned for its unparalleled beauty, resilience, and adaptability, Kentucky bluegrass sod installation has become the preferred solution for discerning Chicago landscapers and homeowners alike. In this comprehensive guide, we'll delve into why this magnificent turfgrass is not just a good choice, but the *best* choice for achieving that picture-perfect lawn right here in the Windy City.
